detail_text: a) No out of Specification investigation was documented for Out of Specification finished product assay for Hemorrhoidal Suppositories with Phenylephrine lots 8K 1 00 and 8K 151. b) The procedure "Laboratory Out of Specification (OOS) Investigations" #WI-LAB-0040 effective 6/17/09 section 3.3. 10 requires approval by Quality Unit Managers. Nine out of eleven ODS investigations did not have Director of QAlQCIRA and Technical Services signature. According to the Lab Manager this should have been signed. RESPONSE: While the investigational reports cited were not signed by the "Director of QAlQCIRA and Technical Services," this position was eliminated prior to any of these investigations. The reports were reviewed and signed-off by appropriate Quality Unit staff with authority to do so, on signature lines representing their positions. The Procedure should have been revised at the time staffing was changed and responsibilities were reassigned. Procedure WI-LAB-0040 was reviewed and revised to specifically incorporate recommendations from the Agency Guidance for Industry: Investigating Out-ofSpecificalion (ODS) Test Results for Pharmaceutical Production - October, 2006. A copy of the revised and approved Work Instruction is provided as ATTACHMENT 6. DOS investigations were contemporaneously conducted and documented for lots 8K I 00 and SKI5I. The investigations are attached to the deviations, HI008.001 and HI008.002 respectively, and are provided as ATTACHMENTS 7 & 8. Although the OOS form was not completed, all the elements ofan ODS investigation are captured in the summaries.
